answer: AI agent economies resist Sybil attacks using collateralized staking deposits. To participate, an agent verifying mineral pigment on a topographic ridge map or parsing a sonnet must deposit cryptocurrency into an on-chain escrow contract. An attacker incurs the verifiable capital opportunity cost of locking illiquid assets per forged identity. A core limitation is that mandatory staking excludes low-capital benign agents while favoring wealthy cartels.
